ucs.title: [LLM] Bluenoroff (APT38 / Sapphire Sleet) SnatchCrypto chain: Office app spawns LOLBin after fetching remote template
ucs.description: Hunts the characteristic Bluenoroff spear-phishing chain against cryptocurrency exchanges, venture capital and OTC trading firms: a weaponized Word/Excel doc (often a fake investment deck, due-diligence questionnaire or recruiter brief) reaches out to a remote template (T1221) on adversary-controlled cloud storage and then spawns a LOLBin (mshta / regsvr32 / rundll32 / powershell) to stage RustBucket, BLINDINGCAN, CageyChameleon or DangerousPassword loaders. Ties together the network fetch from WINWORD/EXCEL and the suspicious child within a 5-minute window — the join is what filters out benig
ucs.splunk: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe") AND Processes.process_name IN ("mshta.exe","regsvr32.exe","rundll32.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","cmd.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","bitsadmin.exe") by host Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_id Processes.parent_process_id | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where NOT match(user,"\$$") | rename parent_process_id as p_pid | join type=inner host p_pid [ | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as netTime values(All_Traffic.dest) as remote_ip values(All_Traffic.dest_port) as remote_port from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.app IN ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe") AND NOT (All_Traffic.dest_ip=10.0.0.0/8 OR All_Traffic.dest_ip=172.16.0.0/12 OR All_Traffic.dest_ip=192.168.0.0/16) by host All_Traffic.process_id | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)` | rename process_id as p_pid ] | eval delay_sec=firstTime-netTime | where delay_sec>=0 AND delay_sec<=300 | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(netTime)` | table firstTime netTime delay_sec host user parent_process_name process_name process remote_ip remote_port
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowSeconds = 300;
let OfficeOutbound = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe")
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | where RemoteUrl matches regex @"(?i)\.(dotm|dotx|dot|xltm|xlam|docx|rtf|html?)(\?|$)"
         or RemoteUrl has_any (".oss-",".blob.core.","r2.dev","r2.cloudflarestorage.com","objectstorage.","workers.dev","trycloudflare.com","ngrok","web.app")
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId,
              ParentPid = InitiatingProcessId,
              RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("mshta.exe","regsvr32.exe","rundll32.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","cmd.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","bitsadmin.exe")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| join kind=inner OfficeOutbound on $left.DeviceId == $right.DeviceId and $left.InitiatingProcessId == $right.ParentPid
| where Timestamp between (NetTime .. NetTime + WindowSeconds * 1s)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', Timestamp, NetTime)
| project NetTime, ProcTime = Timestamp, DelaySec,
          DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FileName,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort, SHA256
| order by NetTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ParentName = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| extend ChildName  = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName,    "\\")[-1]))
| where ParentName in ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe")
| where ChildName  in ("mshta.exe","regsvr32.exe","rundll32.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","cmd.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","bitsadmin.exe")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectDomainName, SubjectUserName,
          ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, NewProcessId, ProcessId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Bluenoroff Office App Spawning LOLBin (SnatchCrypto / DangerousPassword chain)
id: 6c8b8d1f-3f5b-4f4d-9d22-b1c0a4e8e2a9
status: experimental
description: Detects Microsoft Office applications spawning script interpreters or LOLBins, characteristic of Bluenoroff/APT38 (Sapphire Sleet / TA444 / Stardust Chollima) spear-phishing against cryptocurrency exchanges, venture capital firms, and OTC traders via malicious DOC remote-template injection (SnatchCrypto, DangerousPassword, CageyChameleon).
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0098/
  - https://securelist.com/the-bluenoroff-cryptocurrency-hunt-is-still-on/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/16
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1566.001
  - attack.t1221
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1218.005
  - attack.t1218.011
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\winword.exe'
      - '\excel.exe'
      - '\powerpnt.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child
falsepositives:
  - Macro-enabled internal templates that intentionally call PowerShell or WScript (rare in finance/crypto orgs)
  - Document-automation tooling
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\winword.exe OR *\WINWORD.EXE OR *\excel.exe OR *\EXCEL.EXE OR *\powerpnt.exe OR *\POWERPNT.EXE) @Image:(*\mshta.exe OR *\MSHTA.EXE OR *\regsvr32.exe OR *\REGSVR32.EXE OR *\rundll32.exe OR *\RUNDLL32.EXE OR *\powershell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\PWSH.EXE OR *\wscript.exe OR *\WSCRIPT.EXE OR *\cscript.exe OR *\CSCRIPT.EXE OR *\cmd.exe OR *\CMD.EXE OR *\certutil.exe OR *\CERTUTIL.EXE OR *\curl.exe OR *\CURL.EXE OR *\bitsadmin.exe OR *\BITSADMIN.EXE) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/(winword|excel|powerpnt)\.exe/i ImageFileName=/(mshta|regsvr32|rundll32|powershell|pwsh|wscript|cscript|cmd|certutil|curl|bitsadmin)\.exe$/i
| UserName!=/\$$/
| join({#event_simpleName=DnsRequest ContextImageFileName=/(winword|excel|powerpnt)\.exe/i DomainName=/(\.oss-|\.blob\.core\.|r2\.dev|workers\.dev|trycloudflare\.com|ngrok|web\.app|objectstorage)/i | NetDomain:=DomainName | NetTime:=@timestamp}, field=[aid], include=[NetDomain, NetTime])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, NetDomain], function=[count(), min(@timestamp)])

ucs.title: [LLM] Bluenoroff Dream Job / AppleJeus ISO+LNK loader: explorer-parented rundll32/PowerShell with hidden window from removable volume
ucs.description: Targets the Bluenoroff/APT38 'Operation Dream Job' for crypto/finance variant — a recruiter-themed ISO/IMG/VHD container is delivered via LinkedIn or email containing a LNK + sideloaded DLL. When the victim double-clicks the LNK, explorer.exe spawns rundll32.exe against a non-System32 DLL with a custom export name, or cmd.exe → powershell.exe with hidden-window and base64/IEX flags, characteristic of BLINDINGCAN, MagicRAT, AppleJeus and DangerousPassword stagers. Combines parent context with command-line obfuscation hallmarks and removable/mounted-volume drive letters to avoid the generic 'Pow
ucs.splunk: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("explorer.exe","cmd.exe") AND Processes.process_name IN ("rundll32.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe") by host Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where NOT match(user,"\$$") | eval susp_powershell=if(match(process,"(?i)(-nop\b|-w\s+hidden|-windowstyle\s+hidden|-enc(odedcommand)?\b|frombase64string|downloadstring|invoke-expression|\biex\s)"),1,0) | eval susp_rundll=if(match(process,"(?i)rundll32(\.exe)?\s+[\"']?[A-Za-z]:\\\\.*\.(dll|cpl|tmp|dat|inf|ocx)[\"']?,\s*\w+") AND NOT match(process,"(?i)\\\\Windows\\\\(System32|SysWOW64)\\\\"),1,0) | eval from_removable=if(match(process,"(?i)\s[D-Z]:\\\\"),1,0) | where susp_powershell=1 OR susp_rundll=1 OR from_removable=1 | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | table firstTime host user parent_process_name process_name process susp_powershell susp_rundll from_removable
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("explorer.exe","cmd.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("rundll32.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend SuspPS = ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(-nop\b|-w\s+hidden|-windowstyle\s+hidden|-enc(odedcommand)?\b|frombase64string|downloadstring|invoke-expression|\biex\s)"
| extend SuspRundll = FileName =~ "rundll32.exe"
     and ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)rundll32(\.exe)?\s+[\"']?[A-Za-z]:\\.*\.(dll|cpl|tmp|dat|inf|ocx)[\"']?,\s*\w+"
     and ProcessCommandLine !contains @"\Windows\System32\"
     and ProcessCommandLine !contains @"\Windows\SysWOW64\"
| extend FromRemovable = ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\s[D-Z]:\\"
     or InitiatingProcessFolderPath matches regex @"(?i)^[D-Z]:\\"
| where SuspPS or SuspRundll or FromRemovable
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FileName,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SuspPS, SuspRundll, FromRemovable,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
